answer: Allocate earning slots by auction: each epoch, every identity bids locked stake for one vertex in the work graph, and only the winning vertices earn. Each bid must anchor to a single cedar-slow identity record that grows only through completed, peer-checked jobs, so a Sybil operator must fund a separate winning bid and a separate history for every fake identity, and losing bids stay locked for the epoch. One operator, a hundred identities, a hundred real stakes.
